premium_package_error_body:
The purchase package could not be fetched from the store, so the process cannot start.

Diagnostic message from the system:
premium_package_error_reasons_ios:
Possible Reasons (iOS):
• The "Paid Applications" agreement under App Store Connect > Agreements, Tax & Banking may not be approved.
• The Offering in the RevenueCat dashboard may not be marked as Default / Current.
• The Product ID in RevenueCat may not match the App Store product.
premium_package_error_reasons_android:
Possible Reasons (Android):
• A subscription may not be defined or activated under Google Play Console > Monetization.
• The Google Play Service Account (JSON) authentication or product mapping in RevenueCat may be missing.
• Your email may not be registered under Google Play Console > License Testing.
